layout.notFoundBody: The address is wrong, or you aren't a member of this workspace. A public workspace can be joined from Find workspaces.

home.myRolesTitle: My roles and what I can do
home.myRolesSubtitle: Workspace admins assign roles. If you have several roles, their permissions are combined.
home.projectsSubtitle: Projects you can read in this workspace.

members.title: Members
members.description: People in this workspace and their roles.
members.removeBody: They leave this workspace right away and must request to join again to come back.
members.leaveBody: You'll need to request to join again to come back.
members.rolesDialogBody: Choosing several roles combines their permissions. You can't give a role with more permissions than you have.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.body: Only the account with the invited email can accept. The link expires in 7 days.
invite.roleHelp: You can only give roles within your own permissions.
invite.createdBody: Send the link below to {{email}}. Email delivery is off for now, so you need to pass the link on yourself.
invite.linkOnce: The link is shown only this once. If you lose it, revoke the invitation and create a new one.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.

sentInvitations.emptyBody: Invitations you send stay here until they're accepted or expire.
sentInvitations.revokeBody: The link stops working right away. To invite again, create a new invitation.

requests.title: Join requests
requests.description: Approving makes the person a member with the role you choose. Requests expire after 30 days.
requests.emptyPublic: When someone requests to join from Find workspaces, it shows up here.
requests.emptyPrivate: This workspace is private, so it isn't listed and doesn't accept join requests. Make it public in Settings to accept them.
requests.rejectHelp: A rejected person can request again only after a waiting period (7 days by default).

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: A role is a set of permission codes. Members can have several roles, and their permissions are combined. Owner-only permissions (transfer ownership, delete) can't be added to other roles.
roles.deleteBody: Its role group in Keycloak is deleted too. This can't be undone.
roles.cannotEdit: It contains permissions you don't have, so you can't edit it
roles.inUse: Members still have this role (members: {{count}}), so it can't be deleted
roles.isDefault: It's the default role for new members, so it can't be deleted

roleEditor.name: Name
roleEditor.rule: You can only add permissions you have. Owner-only permissions can't be added.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.addressHelp: Also used for MCP connections, so it can't change.
settings.personalNotice: A personal workspace cannot be made public or accept joins.
settings.domainsHelp: Leave empty to let anyone join. Separate several with commas.
settings.joinPolicyPrivate: A private workspace does not accept joins. People enter by invitation only.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: A record of what happened to members, roles, settings, projects, issues and MCP keys. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
audit.noMatchBody: Try changing or clearing the filters.
audit.personHelp: What they did, what was done to them, and what happened to their MCP keys

discover.title: Find workspaces
discover.description: You can join public team workspaces. Private workspaces are not listed here and are entered by invitation only.
discover.search: Search by name, address or description
discover.emptyBody: Try other words, or create a new team workspace.
discover.applied: Request sent. You can enter once an admin approves it.

receivedInvitations.title: Invitations for you
receivedInvitations.subtitle: Accept to become a member right away.
receivedInvitations.declineBody: To join later you'll need a new invitation or a join request.

invitation.title: You're invited to {{name}}
invitation.mismatchTitle: You're signed in with a different account
invitation.mismatchBody: This invitation was sent to {{invited}}, but you're signed in as {{current}}. Sign in with the invited email's account.
invitation.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this workspace. Accepting just closes the invitation.
invitation.closedBody: This invitation is {{status}}. Ask the sender for a new one if you still need it.
invitation.notFoundBody: Check the link. It may have been copied incompletely, or the invitation was replaced.

create.title: New team workspace
create.description: A workspace several people share. The creator becomes the owner and manages members and roles. The address (workspace-…) is assigned automatically.
create.name: Name
create.notAllowed: Only accounts allowed by a system administrator can create team workspaces. Ask a system administrator if you need one.
create.limitReached: You have created all {{limit}} team workspaces you are allowed. Ask a system administrator if you need more.
create.allowance: You can create up to {{limit}} team workspaces. You have created {{created}}, with {{remaining}} left.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: A project groups issues. Each project decides who can read it.
projects.emptyBody: Create a project to add issues and organize them into parents and children.
projects.emptyBodyReader: There is no project you can see in this workspace yet. Admins create projects.
projects.archivedEmptyBody: Archived projects are hidden from readers. You can restore or delete them here.

visibilityHelp.WORKSPACE: Any member of this workspace can read it.
visibilityHelp.RESTRICTED: Only owners, admins and selected members can read it. Other members cannot even see that it exists.

projects.restrictedNote: You choose the members on the project's Members screen by giving them project roles. Owners and admins can always read it.

dialog.keyHelp: The name used in the address. Starts with a lowercase letter and uses only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2–32 characters). It cannot be changed later.
dialog.keyFixed: The address name cannot be changed.
dialog.keyInvalid: Use 2–32 characters starting with a lowercase letter, with only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot end with a hyphen.
dialog.keyTaken: This address name is already used in this workspace.

home.notFoundBody: The project does not exist or you cannot see it.
home.archivedBanner: This project is archived. Readers cannot see it and its issues cannot be changed.

archive.confirmBody: Project to archive: {{name}}. Readers will no longer see it and its issues cannot be changed. You can restore it from the archive at any time.

remove.title: Delete project
remove.body: Project to delete: {{name}}. Once deleted, this project and its issues can no longer be seen. This cannot be undone.
remove.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the address name {{key}}

roleDescriptions.project-admin: Curator + delete issues, project settings, project roles

members.title: Members
members.description: People who have project roles in this project. Several roles combine their permissions.
members.noteWorkspace: All workspace members can read this project (with the permissions of their workspace roles). Roles given here add permissions inside this project only.
members.noteRestricted: Only selected members can read this project: people with a role here, plus workspace owners and admins.
members.removeBody: All roles in this project are removed. Permissions from workspace roles stay as they are.
members.emptyBody: Only the permissions of workspace roles apply in this project.
members.emptyBodyManager: Use Add member to give workspace members a role in this project.
members.rolesDialogBody: Several roles combine their permissions. You cannot give or remove a role beyond your own permissions.
members.addBody: Pick a workspace member and give them a role in this project.
members.membersUnavailable: You cannot see the workspace member list, so you cannot pick a member.

visibilityHelp.PUBLIC: Listed in workspace discovery, and other people can join.
visibilityHelp.PRIVATE: Not visible to others. Only invited people can enter.
